'''Gerind''' was a member of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A mousy, small man, Gerind served as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken's]] assistant.<ref name="SF" />
